Raw hex address 0x56b1ef assigned to bare local `uStack_360`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `uStack_360` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.
Watcom loop-unrolled strcpy (2-byte-at-a-time do-while with mid-body null check). Replace the whole loop with strcpy() in a .keep.
